$comment: NATS JetStream subject trace.completed (ADR-0003). Published by the trace-assembler after trace_summary holds the row. Nats-Msg-Id is trace_id/assembler_version/revision. A new revision is a new message that replaces the earlier ones for the trace. No tenant, service or span content: consumers read those from ClickHouse.
description: A trace was assembled, or re-assembled after later spans.

assembler_version.description: Version of the assembler that wrote the summary (semver).

revision.description: The trace's last arrival (trace_arrivals.ingested_at) in epoch milliseconds: the version of its trace_summary row.

span_count.description: Spans of the trace the assembler read for this revision.
